title: Engine Hesitation on Acceleration
summary: Common causes, likely diagnostic paths, OBD references, and repair-next steps for engine hesitation on acceleration.
intro: Engine hesitation on acceleration usually means airflow, fuel delivery, or combustion timing is not keeping up when the throttle opens. The quickest split is whether the hesitation is lean and surge-like, misfire-related, or tied to a bad airflow signal the ECM cannot trust.
common_sounds: Flat spot when first getting into the throttle
Light surge or stumble before power comes in
Hesitation that is worse merging, climbing, or passing
Occasional backfire or pop if the fault is severe
quick_checks: Scan for lean, misfire, and airflow-performance codes before replacing parts
Review short- and long-term fuel trims at idle and under load
Inspect the intake tract and clamps after the MAF
Check spark plug and coil condition if hesitation feels like a light miss under load
Check fuel delivery if trims stay lean or power falls off as demand rises
common_causes: Weak fuel pump or low fuel delivery
Lean condition from intake or vacuum leak
Worn spark plugs or weak ignition coils
Throttle body airflow or control issue
diagnostic_paths: If fuel trims go lean as throttle opens, verify intake leaks and weak fuel delivery before condemning ignition parts.
If hesitation comes with a clear miss or bucking, start with plug and coil checks before moving deeper.
If airflow readings do not match load and RPM, the MAF path becomes a stronger next step.

recommended_repairs.title: Mass Air Flow Sensor Replacement Cost
recommended_repairs.description: A strong next path when hesitation follows biased airflow data and intake inspection supports the sensor path.

recommended_repairs.title: Fuel Pump Replacement Cost
recommended_repairs.description: Relevant when the hesitation grows worse under heavier throttle and fuel delivery tests weak.

recommended_repairs.title: Throttle Body Replacement Cost
recommended_repairs.description: Useful when throttle response and airflow control are unstable after inspection and relearn checks.

recommended_repairs.title: Spark Plug Replacement Cost
recommended_repairs.description: A practical next path when hesitation is tied to weak spark demand under load.

recommended_repairs.title: Ignition Coil Replacement Cost
recommended_repairs.description: Worth pricing when plug condition is acceptable but load-related ignition weakness is still present.
